item.title: Becky G Reveals Who She’s Rooting for in the 2026 World Cup: ‘I Have Two Flags to Represent’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and trends in music. Today, we're talking about the World Cup and how it's bringing people together, including music stars like Becky G.
[Music transitions to a lively, upbeat tune]
Host: As the World Cup continues to captivate fans around the globe, Becky G is showing her team spirit. The Mexican-American artist has been cheering on both the Mexican and U.S.A. national teams, and recently shared her excitement in an interview.
[Clip of Becky G's interview plays]
Becky G: "I'm a proud Chicana. I'm Mexican-American... Born and raised in Los Angeles, it's been quite the festivities... And to know that we are from one of the hosting countries, and then actually got to be the opener in Mexico. I don't think I'll ever experience anything as magical."
Host: Becky G has been attending matches, including the Mexico vs. South Africa game and the U.S. vs. Paraguay match. And with Mexico advancing to the round of 16 and the U.S. set to play in the round of 32, she's got plenty to cheer about.
[Music transitions to a patriotic tune]
Host: When it comes to the best World Cup hype song, Becky G opts for a classic. She chooses the Woody Guthrie song "This Land is Your Land", saying it represents the warmth and opportunity that the United States offers to people from all over the world.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's podcast. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
